system.description: An extra level of Auspex unique to the Malkavian elder Jacob (of Milwaukee), Insight of the Mad grants an intuitive, almost precognitive understanding of the fears and desires of everyone nearby, letting the user tailor manipulation and offers to exploit exactly what a target secretly wants or dreads. It pairs naturally with Presence-based coercion powers such as Coax.
system.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred (Jacob/Esau)
